adapters.neumat_alias: experiments/rna_reproduction/rr_run.py registers neumat/neumat.config as aliases of rna/rna.config so the released checkpoints unpickle (their hyper-parameters reference neumat.config.BaseNeuMatConfig, the package's pre-release name); without it torch.load fails (ModuleNotFoundError: neumat). Non-behavioural.
adapters.render_json_path: the released render yml names config/render/jsons/lego.json but the file is config/render/lego.json; the workspace holds a byte-identical copy at the named path; yml unchanged
adapters.dataset_paths: generation via the upstream --dataset_name option (the released train/val generate configs share one output name); the train yml's more_data/training_data/11-2023/Lego_hq{,_val}.h5 are symlinks to the generated files; yml unchanged
adapters.workspace: results/rna_reproduction/work (cwd), PYTHONPATH = upstream checkout; upstream scripts run unchanged

table1_HQ_4x512.metric: average validation PSNR, Lego (paper Table 1); code-defined as mean over 40 views of PSNR(tonemap(pred), tonemap(gt)), tonemap = clamp, x/(1+x), ^(1/2.2), alpha>0 pixels

classification_rules.released_checkpoint_route: evaluate lego.ckpt / lego_rt.ckpt (final, epoch 249) on the natively regenerated 40-view validation set through the unchanged Lightning validate path: REPRODUCED if |view-mean PSNR - Table 1| <= 1.0 dB for both variants, COMPARABLE if <= 2.0 dB, otherwise DISCREPANT (to be attributed). 1.0 dB covers the observed run/val-set spread (worklog 33: 0.5 dB between identical-config runs) plus final-vs-best (released logs: best 33.94 vs Table 34.09)
classification_rules.training_route: if the 400-view set is generated: train lego_vis.yml and lego_vis_rt.yml unchanged (seed 0, 250 epochs); REPRODUCED if the logged best val_psnr is within 1.0 dB of Table 1 and the final within 1.0 dB of the released final checkpoint's value on the same validation set; COMPARABLE within 2.0 dB
classification_rules.fig8_route: masked LDR PSNR of the lego_cmp frames is reported as COMPARABLE only (unpublished protocol)
